instructions.en: Choose the approach that feels more natural to you currently in each situation. Both choices are acceptable; neither is a correct answer. Consider your own current way of interacting, without a required recall period. All 24 choices are needed before any of the four comparisons is interpreted. If neither option fits or you do not wish to choose, you may leave the attempt unfinished; a missing answer is never converted into the other side. This bank records interaction choices and does not ask you to increase disclosure, perform warmth or contact anyone.
instructions.zh: 每个情境选择目前对自己更自然的做法。两种选择都成立，没有标准答案。按自己目前的互动方式作答，不设固定回忆期限。完整选择24题后才解释四组比较。两项都不适合或不愿选择时，可以保留未完成状态；缺题不会算到另一侧。题组只记录互动选择，不要求增加披露、表演热情或联系任何人。

scoringPolicy: Faithful Mini arithmetic: four independent 6-choice paired counts, each pair sums 6. Top side by within-pair count only; 3:3 retains both sorted pole codes. No total, cross-pair ranking, combined type, percentiles, thresholds, attractiveness or outcome prediction. No NA option was present in the source form: missing answers leave the whole attempt incomplete with no interpretation. All four complete guides always displayed after valid completion, each explaining both sides and ties.

originalRightsEvidence.evidence: User-owned Mini source as actually read, not an external item-bank licence. No third-party Mote items, result prose or archetype map copied. New English is a translation of the user-owned 24 Chinese items; new guides are FermatMind editorial content.

languageEquivalence: Chinese 24 prompts and 48 options, IDs, order and pole mapping preserved exactly. English new translation; no empirical validation or cross-language measurement invariance claimed.
modelDifference: JobCannon has 16 Likert statements summed into four named charm archetypes on two conceptual axes. This reuse is the different FermatMind four-comparison original Mini model, without archetype assignment or attractiveness claims. Title/SEO must state the local scope clearly.
